content.text:
A camera's `up` vector now survives a save-and-load round trip. I haven't run anything, not even the issue's reproduction or the existing test suite.

The cause was that `up` was never written out at all, so the loader had nothing to restore and fell back to the default (0,1,0). The fix is three lines in two files:

- **`src/core/Object3D.js`:** `toJSON()` now saves `object.up = this.up.toArray()` next to the matrix.
- **`src/loaders/ObjectLoader.js`:** `parseObject()` now restores it with `object.up.fromArray( data.up )` when the field is present.

Because the change is in `Object3D`, it applies to every object, not just cameras. Files saved before this change have no `up` field, so they still load with the default. One side effect: every object's saved JSON now has an extra `up` field. Any existing test that compares `toJSON()` output exactly will need its expected value updated.
